config.label: Your Siglio API key
config.description: Your Siglio API key. Sandbox keys start with sig_sandbox_ and live keys start with sig_live_. Get one at https://esigndev.com

config.label: Set to true to allow a live key
config.description: Set to true to allow a live key. Without it, live keys are refused and only sandbox keys will run. Leave unset while testing.
